annotations.title: What each detailed line item means, per market

description: The data dictionary of the detailed line items: for every metric, its definition, which filed line each market reads it from (or why a market has none), and the measured share of that market's company-periods that carry it; the figures we calculate from them, with their formulas; and the rules that apply to all of them (dating, signs, annual-only cash-flow lines, small employers). Use it before comparing a line item across markets, or to learn what a line-item code means. It also defines company.industry and company.status (the register's industry code and legal status, with source and dates), per market. Codes: trade_receivables, trade_and_other_receivables, inventories, trade_payables, trade_and_other_payables, ppe, noncurrent_assets, current_assets, current_liabilities, retained_earnings, depreciation_amortization, interest_expense, cash_flow_operating, capex, minority_interest, temporary_equity, land_and_buildings, land, buildings, pension_provisions, cost_of_materials, purchases_of_goods, purchases_of_materials, wages_and_salaries, operating_taxes, income_tax; calculated: free_cash_flow, working_capital, current_ratio, ebitda.
